comparisons.existing: PreRhoNorm.gramData, PreRhoAlignment.gramData and their actualNormData/actualAlignmentData bindings
comparisons.reuse: Use the existing six-correlation polynomial definitions literally, including p0,p0bar,p1,p1bar,eta,c0,c1. No parallel invariant formulas or side construction.

Import the exact existing U,V,c6 numerators and common denominator. U and V have the same literal denominator; c6 numerator is four times this denominator. Share that input and kernel-check three cleared identities, rather than recomputing any symbolic norm or discovering coefficients.

Their actual centered linear/quadratic equations are the target physical formulas. Previously recorded rational comparisons are not Lean proofs and remain so until these source-pinned identities compile and pass an axiom audit.

comparisons.difference: A general real polynomial substitution theorem in an atlas carrier model. Here the fixed four complex phase denominators are explicit monomials; existing FieldSimp/Ring suffice without importing a second carrier model or running atlas work.

comparisons.reuse: Keep existing eliminant formulas for later entry bindings. Leading-fibre results concern finiteness and do not certify the original cached U,V rational coefficients.

limits: Three starting coefficient identities, not the universal norm certificate. Every phase denominator remains explicit. No coverage claim for unshared work.

generator_review.description: Only serializes pinned U,V,c6 cached rational coefficients, shares their exact matching denominator, and emits three denominator-cleared identities against existing PreRhoNorm.gramData. No external computation is accepted as a proof; Lean FieldSimp/Ring must close every identity. No atlas data or norm certificate is generated.
